items.title: Kushner seeks to revive Gaza peace as Netanyahu resists Hamas disarmament
items.description: US envoy Jared Kushner meets Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday after talks with Hamas in Egypt, seeking to revive the second phase of a Gaza peace plan stalled over Israel’s demand for the group’s complete disarmament.
items.titleIt: Kushner seeks to revive Gaza peace as Netanyahu resists Hamas disarmament

items.title: 'Emergency' ship rescues migrant boat, 7 dead
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 17 - Emergency's Life Support rescue ship rescued a boat with about fifty migrants on board Monday morning in international waters in the Libyan SAR zone. Seven migrants died during the crossing, and two are in serious condition due to suffocation, the NGO reports. "The shipwrecked people," Emergency explains, "reported they departed at dawn on August 16 from Zuwara, and are originally from Somalia and Egypt. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.

items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. items.title: Worries grow over mysterious illness killing Kenyan elephants
items.description: Worries over the death of elephants are mounting in southern Kenya, where at least 19 animals have died since June from an unexplained condition. items.title: Sudan: Women Demand Inclusive, Safe Dialogue to End Sudan War for Good
items.description: [Dabanga] Nairobi / Amsterdam -- Sudanese feminist and civil society figures have called for broader participation in any anticipated Sudanese-Sudanese dialogue, demanding genuine guarantees to protect participants and provide a safe space for discussion. They stressed the need for women, young people, and civil society to play an active role in the political process.
